record.body:
## Problem

Oracle hashes cover only the test files. An agent can still earn a pass by editing `conftest.py`, fixtures, or `pytest.ini`, adding a skip elsewhere, changing the runner command, or making source detect that it runs under test.

## Approach

Adopt `support-files-schema` and `freeze-lint`. Wave 1 runs `env-freeze` (R1, R2) and `witness-lint` (R3, R4) in parallel as subagents. Wave 2 is `verify-frozen-environment`. Manifest declares `support_files`; claims may list support paths; hashes and a canonical runner-argv digest join the signed amendment chain; lint reports no-assert witnesses and new skips. Phase-end reviewer runs (campaign milestone).

## Exit criteria

- Verdict fails when a declared support file or the runner digest changes without a covering amendment.
- Lint flags a no-assert witness and a newly added skip.
- Existing oracle amendment pass/fail cases still hold.

## Landing

- **branch:** `phase/frozen-environment`
- **worktree:** `/home/andrewyin/affidavit--frozen-environment`
- **base:** `main`
- **close:** commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into `main`; commit the store on the primary checkout
- **push:** not a stop (do not push)

## Run

One sitting. No human stops (campaign plan-review pre-approved; Landing automerge). Every task is `subagent`.

Wave 1 is `env-freeze` (25 minutes) and `witness-lint` (15), so 25 minutes. Wave 2 is `verify-frozen-environment` (12). Phase elapsed is 37 minutes.

Wave 1 writes disjoint trees: `env-freeze` edits `affidavit/manifest.py`, `affidavit/amendment.py`, `affidavit/verdict.py`, and their tests; `witness-lint` adds `affidavit/lint.py`, extends `affidavit/cli.py` for lint only, and adds lint tests. Wave 2 runs acceptance commands and does not add features.

payload.title: Freeze the witness environment, not just the test files
